# Privé by Luchi

> Privé by Luchi is a luxury **mobile braiding studio** based in Lagos, Nigeria. We bring the full salon experience to your door — knotless braids, box braids, faux locs, butterfly locs, cornrows, stitch braids and frontal installs — across Lagos and anywhere in Nigeria (logistics covered by the client). Founder and lead stylist: Chioma Christine Cletus.

## About

- **Business:** Privé by Luchi — Luxury Mobile Braiding Studio
- **Location:** Lagos, Nigeria (mobile — we travel to the client)
- **Area served:** Lagos and nationwide across Nigeria
- **Booking:** Online at https://privebyluchi.com (1 appointment per day, book at least 48 hours ahead)
- **Hours:** Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM
- **Payment:** Naira (NGN). A deposit secures each appointment; the balance is paid on the day.
- **Contact:** WhatsApp +234 815 697 3807 · luxuriousluchihairs@gmail.com
- **Instagram/TikTok:** @priveby_luchi

## Services and starting prices (NGN)

Prices vary by braid size (smaller = more time = higher price). Starting prices:

- **Knotless / Box Braids** — from ₦45,000 (Large) up to ₦80,000 (X-Small). 5–8 hrs.
- **Fulani / Cornrows** — from ₦45,000. 3–5 hrs.
- **Stitch Braids** — from ₦45,000. 4–6 hrs.
- **Faux Locs** — from ₦40,000. 3–5 hrs.
- **Butterfly Locs** — from ₦45,000 (varies with length, 12–30 inches). 4–6 hrs.
- **Frontal / Ponytail / Closure Install** — from ₦35,000. 1–2 hrs.
- **Add-ons:** extra length, boho curls, beads & accessories (from ₦10,000).

## How to book

1. Open https://privebyluchi.com and choose your braid style.
2. Pick your size and any add-ons; the price updates live.
3. Choose an available date and time (book at least 48 hours ahead).
4. Enter your name, phone, email and address so the stylist can come to you.
5. Pay the deposit to lock in the slot; the balance is settled on the appointment day.

## Frequently asked questions

- **Do you really come to my house?** Yes. Privé by Luchi is a mobile studio — the stylist travels to your home or venue in Lagos, and anywhere in Nigeria (travel logistics are covered by the client).
- **How far ahead should I book?** At least 48 hours. We take one appointment per day for a focused, unrushed finish.
- **Do you provide the hair/extensions?** Premium hair can be arranged; tell us your preference when booking and we advise on length and quantity.
- **How long do braids take?** Most styles take 3–8 hours depending on size and length.
- **How do I keep braids fresh?** Sleep in a satin/silk bonnet, cleanse the scalp every 1–2 weeks, keep hair moisturised, and take braids down within 6–8 weeks.
- **What areas do you cover?** All of Lagos (Mainland and Island) and the rest of Nigeria on request.
